fullPassage: It may be assumed that meta-algorithmics, that is, the creation of algorithms that generate other algorithms, is a human creation as well. A human programmer must have composed the first algorithm that, in turn, generates new algorithms and as such the initial programmer must be in control of the original idea. However, this is not necessarily true. Unlike humanly conceived ideas, where the author is the intellectual owner of the idea, algorithms are processes that define, describe, and implement a series of actions that in turn produce other actions. During the transfer of actions it is possible for a discrepancy to occur between the original intention and the actual result. If that happens then, by definition, the author of the algorithm is not in control of, and therefore does not own intellectually from that point on, the resulting process. Theoretically, ownership of an idea is intrinsically connected to the predictability of its outcome, that is, to its intellectual control. Therefore, in the absence of human control the ownership of the algorithmic process must be instead credited to the device that produced it, that is, to the computer.

A human programmer must have composed the first algorithm that, in turn, generates new algorithms and as such the initial programmer must be in control of the original idea. However, this is not necessarily true. Unlike humanly conceived ideas, where the author is the intellectual owner of the idea, algorithms are processes that define, describe, and implement a series of actions that in turn produce other actions. During the transfer of actions it is possible for a discrepancy to occur between the original intention and the actual result. If that happens then, by definition, <u>the author of the algorithm is not in control of</u>, and therefore does not own intellectually from that point on, the resulting process. Theoretically, ownership of an idea is intrinsically connected to the predictability of its outcome, that is, to its intellectual control. Therefore, in the absence of human control the ownership of the algorithmic process must be instead credited to the device that produced it, that is, to the computer.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 'the author of the algorithm is not in control of'가 함축하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 통제 상실 = 지적 소유권 상실. 바로 다음에 'does not own intellectually'로 연결

✅ ① 통제 상실이 곧 소유권 이탈을 의미. 원문에서 통제→소유권 연결 명시 ←정답
❌ ② 코드 수정 불가는 언급 없음. 지적 소유권의 문제
❌ ③ 독자적 행동은 과장된 해석. 의도-결과 괴리의 문제
❌ ④ 존재 인지 불가는 원문과 무관한 극단적 해석
det.tip: not in control of → does not own intellectually → 소유권 이탈
